//: TEMPLATE FILE — this file is NEVER read by the app. It shows one complete ELECTRIC model and one complete DIESEL model with every field explained. To add a real machine: copy the matching template block below into the correct machineType's `models` array in machines.json, replace every placeholder value, delete the comment lines (any key starting with //), then run `npm run validate-data`.
//confidence: ANY value in specs or costs may optionally be written as an object { "value": <the value>, "confidence": "confirmed" | "estimate" | "pending" } instead of the plain value. If you write the plain value, it counts as "confirmed". Example: "fuelTankL": { "value": 300, "confidence": "estimate" }

templates.// id: Unique identifier, lowercase, no spaces. Must not match any other model's id. Example: sw960e
templates.// displayName: Full name shown on cards, chart legend and print. Example: SANY SW960E (Electric)
templates.// modelCode: The short factory model code, as printed on the machine. Example: SW960E
templates.// machineType: Must exactly match the id of the machineType block this model sits inside (e.g. wheel-loader).
templates.// energyType: Either "electric" or "diesel" — decides which fields are required and how running costs are calculated.
templates.// imageAsset: Path to the machine's cutout image, relative to the src/ folder. Put the image file there first — validation checks it exists.

specs.// operatingWeightKg: Optional. Operating weight in kilograms, e.g. 20000
specs.// ratedPayloadKg: Optional. Rated payload in kilograms, e.g. 5800
specs.// bucketCapacityM3: Optional. Bucket capacity in cubic metres, e.g. 3.5
specs.// batteryCapacityKWh: Required. Battery capacity in kWh, e.g. 422
specs.// chargerRatingKW: Required. Charger rating in kW, e.g. 320
specs.// gunsPerCharger: Required. Number of charging guns per charger, e.g. 2
specs.// chargeTime20to80: Required. Charging time from 20% to 80%, written out, e.g. 0.8 h (20% → 80%)
specs.// chargeTime20to100: Required. Charging time from 20% to 100%, e.g. 1.5 h (20% → 100%)
specs.// workHoursPerCharge: Required. Work hours per full charge, e.g. 7 – 9 h
specs.// chargeCycles: Required. Battery charge-cycle life, e.g. 4,000+ cycles
specs.// ratedConsumption: Required. Rated energy consumption as printed on the spec sheet. unit must be kWh/h for electric.
specs.// operatingLifeHours: Required. Machine operating life, written out, e.g. 30,000 – 35,000 h
specs.// warrantySummary: Optional. One-line warranty summary, e.g. 5,000 h / 2 years
specs.// warrantyTiers: Required. One row per warranty tier: what is covered (item) and for how long (terms). Electric machines typically have three tiers: whole machine; battery + drive motor + electric control; axle + hydraulic pump + gearbox.

costs.// priceExVat: Required. Machine selling price in Rand, EXCLUDING VAT, as a plain number (no commas, no R). e.g. 3150000
costs.// consumptionBreakpoints: Required. How consumption changes with how hard the machine works. Each pair is [operation slider value 50–100, consumption in kWh/h]. The calculator draws straight lines between the points. Slider values must go upward and cover 50 to 100. e.g. [[50, 20], [65, 30], [85, 35], [100, 40]]
costs.// routineServicePerHour: Required. Routine mechanical service cost in Rand per operating hour. Electric machines are usually 0.
costs.// maintenancePerYearAt2000h: Required. Scheduled maintenance cost in Rand per year when the machine runs 2,000 h/year. e.g. 53877
costs.// maintenancePerYearAt3000h: Required. Scheduled maintenance cost in Rand per year when the machine runs 3,000 h/year. e.g. 75377
costs.// batteryReplacement: Required for electric. When the battery needs replacing (atHours, in operating hours) and what it costs today in Rand ex VAT (cost). e.g. { "atHours": 30000, "cost": 1120000 }

templates.// id: Unique identifier, lowercase, no spaces. Must not match any other model's id. Example: syl958h5
templates.// displayName: Full name shown on cards, chart legend and print. Example: SANY SYL958H5 (Diesel)
templates.// modelCode: The short factory model code. Example: SYL958H5
templates.// machineType: Must exactly match the id of the machineType block this model sits inside (e.g. wheel-loader).
templates.// variant: Optional. Short label when the SAME model is sold in more than one configuration/price (one entry per configuration), e.g. "dry brake" / "wet brake". Shown after the model name. Leave the field out if there is only one configuration.
templates.// imageAsset: Path to the machine's cutout image, relative to the src/ folder. Put the image file there first — validation checks it exists.

specs.// operatingWeightKg: Optional. Operating weight in kilograms, e.g. 17100
specs.// ratedPayloadKg: Optional. Rated payload in kilograms, e.g. 5000
specs.// bucketCapacityM3: Optional. Bucket capacity in cubic metres, e.g. 3
specs.// engine: Required. Engine make/model and power, written out, e.g. Cummins QSL8.9-C220 III, ~164 kW @ 2200 rpm
specs.engine: ENGINE MAKE & MODEL, ~XXX kW @ XXXX rpm
specs.// fuelTankL: Required. Fuel tank size in litres, e.g. 300
specs.// ratedConsumption: Required. Rated fuel consumption as printed on the spec sheet. unit must be L/h for diesel.
specs.// warrantySummary: Optional. One-line warranty summary, e.g. 4,000 h / 2 years
specs.// warrantyTiers: Required. One row per warranty tier: what is covered (item) and for how long (terms).

costs.// priceExVat: Required. Machine selling price in Rand, EXCLUDING VAT, as a plain number (no commas, no R). e.g. 1850000
costs.// consumptionBreakpoints: Required. How fuel use changes with how hard the machine works. Each pair is [operation slider value 50–100, consumption in litres/h]. Slider values must go upward and cover 50 to 100. e.g. [[50, 10], [65, 12], [85, 14], [100, 16]]
costs.// routineServicePerHour: Required. Routine engine-service cost in Rand per operating hour, e.g. 29 (= R29,000 per 1,000 h).
costs.// maintenancePerYearAt2000h: Required. Scheduled maintenance cost in Rand per year at 2,000 h/year, e.g. 74873
costs.// maintenancePerYearAt3000h: Required. Scheduled maintenance cost in Rand per year at 3,000 h/year, e.g. 91373
costs.// overhaul: Required key for diesel, but the value may be null. null means the machine has NO separate engine-overhaul event (its engine care is covered by routineServicePerHour). If it DOES have one, write { "intervalHours": 12000, "cost": 350000 } — overhaul every intervalHours operating hours, costing that many Rand each time.
